॥ શ્રી સ્વામિનારાયણોવિજયતેતરામ્ ॥

કાળ Patrak

A calendar for 1,000,000 years. First layer: Shri Swaminarayan's life, day by day.

Scroll or pinch to zoom from a million years down to a single day · drag to move · tap a picture to open that day

Sources. Daily charitra from April 1781 to June 1830 is transcribed from શ્રી સ્વામિનારાયણમ્ (Shri Swaminarayanam), ed. Shastri Swami Nirgundasji, Shri Sahajanand Gurukul, Asarva, 2015 (the whole register; July–August 1782 was missing from the copy used). Misprints are kept as printed and noted on the day. The text is the book's and remains the copyright of Shri Sahajanand Gurukul, Asarva. Vachanamrut days come from the Vachanamrut; other life events from the traditional granths (Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani) and the SKSST timeline, with each day showing its own source. Where no source gives the tithi, it is computed from modern sun and moon positions at sunrise (Chhapaiya until Aug 1799, Gadhada after) and marked ગણતરી; traditional panchangs can differ by one tithi near a kshaya or repeated tithi. Weekdays and English dates use the Gregorian calendar, extended backwards before 1582. Events added with “Record an event” are shared with everyone who can open this page.
